entities.summary: Wily Peralta is a Dominican professional baseball pitcher for the Dorados de Chihuahua of the Mexican League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Milwaukee Brewers, Kansas City Royals, and Detroit Tigers.
